Effective line: The gates swing open on a hall lined with posters of Chancellor Clench. There are no weights anywhere. Not a dumbbell.
Suggested line: The gates swing open on a hall papered with posters of Chancellor Clench, and there isn't a single weight anywhere in it, not even a dumbbell.

Effective line: Not a kettlebell. Not a single decorative plate.
Suggested line: Every rack along the walls stands empty, right down to the little pegs where the decorative plates used to hang.

Effective line: Somewhere beneath your feet, something is not quite silent. It is breathing. Slowly. On purpose.
Suggested line: Somewhere far beneath your feet, something is breathing, slow and even, as if it has been counting every breath for a very long time.

Effective line: Iron-less steel, floodlights, and a banner reading MANDATORY CARDIO. Nobody has ever left through here.
Suggested line: Bare steel and floodlights under a banner reading MANDATORY CARDIO. Iron is banned here, and nobody has ever left through these gates.

Effective line: An enforcer searches your bag for weights while a clerk clicks a stopwatch. Minister Quota wants every search done in thirty seconds. He is at forty.
Suggested line: An enforcer searches your bag for weights while a clerk times him with a stopwatch. Minister Quota wants every search done in thirty seconds, and he's already at forty.

Effective line: The prisoners are very quiet. The guards are very loud. Only one of these is a problem.
Suggested line: The prisoners keep very quiet and the guards are very loud, and it doesn't take long to work out which of them is afraid.

Effective line: The warden has never once lifted a weight. He has never needed to. He is very, very angry. (Elite)
Suggested line: The warden has never lifted a weight in his life, has never needed to, and is furious with everyone who has. (Elite)

Effective line: At the bottom of the prison: one cell, one prisoner, one very long breath.
Suggested line: At the very bottom of the prison there is a single cell, and from inside it comes one long, slow breath.

Effective line: The warden drops his keyring. At the end of the corridor, behind a door with no handle, someone is doing a very slow, very controlled push-up.
Suggested line: The warden's keyring clatters to the floor. At the end of the corridor, behind a door with no handle, someone is doing a push-up so slow and controlled it seems to take a full minute.

Effective line: Rows of lockers hold the old champions' gear, every strap labelled by weight class. A laminated sign reads LOCKER 13 IS A STATE OF MIND. One door hangs ajar, humming a training-montage tune to itself.
Suggested line: Rows of lockers hold the old champions' gear, every strap labelled by weight class. A laminated sign reads LOCKER 13 IS A STATE OF MIND. One door hangs ajar, and something inside is humming a marching tune to itself.

Effective line: It smells of victory, eucalyptus and somebody else's victory. It is also warm. You feel sturdier and very slightly watched.
Suggested line: The towel is still warm and smells of eucalyptus and somebody else's victory. You feel sturdier with it round your neck, and very slightly watched.

Effective line: Protein bars, a roll of gold and a note: 'Spotter knows.' Somewhere a whistle blows. You keep the gold and the shame.
Suggested line: Inside are protein bars, a roll of gold and a note that says 'Spotter knows.' Somewhere down the hall a whistle blows, and you leave with the gold and a guilty conscience.

Effective line: He miscounts your reps on purpose, to be encouraging. You leave taller, if not stronger, and he presses a Gym Bro's number into your hand.
Suggested line: The ghost miscounts your reps on purpose, always upward, to be encouraging. You walk away standing taller, if not stronger, and he presses a Gym Bro's number into your hand.

Effective line: A barricade of stacked weight plates, painted regulation red. Behind it, a ferret in a pinstriped suit is timing a guard's push-ups with a silver stopwatch.
Suggested line: Someone has built a barricade out of weight plates painted regulation red. Behind it, a ferret in a pinstriped suit is timing a guard's push-ups with a silver stopwatch.

Effective line: Forty-one. Forty-two. Stop. Eleven percent slower than yesterday. We will discuss it at your review.
Suggested line: Forty-one, forty-two, and stop. Eleven percent slower than yesterday, which we will discuss at your review.

Effective line: And you. You walked in at a pace of seven out of ten. Disappointing. But measurable.
Suggested line: And you walked in at a pace of seven out of ten. Disappointing, but at least it's measurable.

Effective line: Hold still. I'm measuring you. Grip: low. Stride: uneven. Resolve... unusually high. That is an inefficiency. Let's remove it.
Suggested line: Hold still while I measure you. Grip, low. Stride, uneven. Resolve... unusually high, and that is an inefficiency I intend to remove.

Effective line: I will note it. I note everything. The Chancellor will not enjoy this figure.
Suggested line: I'll note it, the way I note everything. The Chancellor is not going to enjoy this figure.

Effective line: You face Chancellor Clench's personal guard. Their uniforms are pressed; their technique could use ironing out. (Elite)
Suggested line: You face Chancellor Clench's personal guard, whose uniforms are pressed to perfection and whose technique is mostly shouting. (Elite)

Effective line: Trophies of every leader the regime ever overthrew. There is an empty one for Grandmaster Flex.
Suggested line: The regime keeps a trophy for every leader it ever overthrew, and one pedestal stands empty, waiting for Grandmaster Flex.

Effective line: Careful, son. The guards time their rounds by their squats.
Suggested line: Quietly, son. The guards time their rounds by counting their squats, and they lose count.

Effective line: Their squats are not regular, so neither are the rounds. Listen for the knees on the stairs.
Suggested line: So the rounds come whenever they come. Listen for knees cracking on the stairs, and you'll hear them in good time.

Effective line: You're Grandmaster Flex? You're... smaller than the posters.
Suggested line: You're Grandmaster Flex? Everyone up there talks about you as if you were twice this size.

Effective line: Ten years in the dark does that. They took the plates, the protein, the pump. I had nothing.
Suggested line: Ten years in the dark will do that. They took my plates, my protein, every bar I ever lifted, and left me with nothing at all.

Effective line: So I had everything. My breath. My body. My mind.
Suggested line: And nothing, it turns out, is a fine place to start. I still had my breath, my body and my mind, so I trained them every day.

Effective line: Come, son. We will climb out together. And I would like a word with Clench. He was the best student I ever had.
Suggested line: Come, son, we'll climb out together. I'd like a word with Clench on the way. He was the best student I ever had. He still is.

Effective line: "Breathe in. Hold. Breathe out," says Grandmaster Flex.
Suggested line: "Breathe in slowly and hold it. Now let it all go," says Grandmaster Flex, breathing along with you.

Effective line: This trophy is reserved. For the Chancellor. For anyone but you.
Suggested line: Reserves, off your pedestal! This trophy belongs to the Chancellor, not to some stranger off the wheels!

Effective line: Chancellor Clench stands before an enormous bench press, the only weight left in the whole House of Gains. It is his.
Suggested line: Chancellor Clench stands in front of an enormous bench press, the only weight left in the whole House of Gains, and he guards it like a throne.

Effective line: "Master." The word sticks in his throat. "I was your best, you know. Your star pupil."
Suggested line: "Master." The word sticks in his throat. "I was your best, you know - your star pupil."

Effective line: "You said I would go further than you ever did. Then you said strength lived in the heart and the head. I knew better."
Suggested line: "You told me I'd go further than you ever did. Then you started on about strength living in the heart and the head, and I knew better."

Effective line: "I took your iron, your protein, your followers. You have come back with nothing, Master."
Suggested line: "I took your iron, your protein and your followers, and you've climbed back up here with nothing, Master."

Effective line: "Look how far I went, Master. What do you think you can do?"
Suggested line: "Look how far I went, Master. What exactly do you think you can do about it now?"

Effective line: Strength is control. Control is paperwork. Paperwork is HEAVY. Two more plates!
Suggested line: Control is strength, paperwork is control, and do you know how HEAVY paperwork gets? Two more plates!

Effective line: The regime's throne room is a gym with a single throne-shaped bench press. It is the only barbell in the House.
Suggested line: The regime's throne room is a gym with one throne-shaped bench press in it, the only barbell left in the House.

Effective line: "Nobody goes down," he says. "Unless."
Suggested line: "Nobody goes down," he says. Then, after a long and meaningful pause: "Unless..."

Effective line: You win the wrestle. He wins the first three rounds of it. The way down is open, and so is your lip.
Suggested line: You win the wrestle, though he wins the first three rounds of it. The way down is open, and so is your lip.

Effective line: He will guard it with his life until you leave. Then it is yours again.
Suggested line: He'll guard it with his life until you leave the House, and then it's yours again.

Effective line: You see no bar or bench, only stone worn smooth by ten years of training. Your chest tightens at the sight of the cell; you do not know why.
Suggested line: There's no bar or bench in the cell, only stone worn smooth by ten years of training. Something about the bare walls tightens your chest, and you couldn't say why.

Effective line: The lock gives. Grandmaster Flex rises, slowly, unsteadily, and bows. He is so thin you could count his ribs.
Suggested line: The lock gives. Grandmaster Flex rises slowly, a little unsteady on his feet, and bows to you. He is so thin you could count his ribs.

Effective line: You read the plate on the empty pedestal: GRANDMASTER FLEX (PENDING). It has been dusted. Recently.
Suggested line: The plate on the empty pedestal reads GRANDMASTER FLEX (PENDING), and someone has dusted it very recently.

Effective line: Medals jingle. Grandmaster Flex winces. "They are not ours to take.
Suggested line: The medals jingle as you scoop them up, and Grandmaster Flex winces. "They are not ours to take, son."

Effective line: Still. The regime owes this house a debt, and gold settles debts." You feel a little guilty, and a little richer.
Suggested line: "Still, the regime owes this house a great deal, and gold settles debts." You feel a little guilty, and a little richer.

Effective line: Some things are not for taking. Grandmaster Flex nods once, slowly, in approval.
Suggested line: You leave the hall exactly as you found it, and Grandmaster Flex gives you one slow nod of approval.

Effective line: You bring that... that stick of a man into my house? Look at him, Master. Ten years on bread and water.
Suggested line: You brought that... that stick of a man into MY house? Look at you, Master. Ten years on bread and water, and you still won't stay down.

Effective line: Hold my coat.
Suggested line: Stand back a little, son. It has been a long time, and I would like some room.

Effective line: You only ever took the weight. I taught you the heart, and you stopped listening before I got to the mind.
Suggested line: You only ever wanted the weight, my boy. I was teaching you the heart, and you stopped listening before I ever got to the mind.

Effective line: ...What. How. Where were you HIDING all of that?
Suggested line: ...How? Ten years in a hole with nothing - where were you HIDING all of that?

Effective line: True strength is not the ability to lift heavy things. It comes from the heart, and from the mind.
Suggested line: Strength was never about how heavy a thing is, Clench. It lives in the heart and the mind, and nobody can lock those in a cell.

Effective line: The heavy things were only ever practice. Now, my boy. Shall we?
Suggested line: The heavy things were only ever practice, my boy. Now, shall we?

Effective line: Chancellor Clench stands before an enormous bench press, the only weight left in the whole House of Gains. It is his.
Suggested line: Chancellor Clench stands in front of an enormous bench press, the only weight left in the whole House of Gains, and he guards it like a throne.

Effective line: Flex does not gloat. He kneels beside his fallen pupil and offers a hand. "You hated yourself for needing the iron, my boy.
Suggested line: Flex doesn't gloat. He kneels beside his fallen pupil and offers him a hand. "You hated yourself for needing the iron, my boy.

Effective line: You watch Grandmaster Flex enter the throne room in his prison rags. No one speaks.
Suggested line: Grandmaster Flex walks into the throne room in his prison rags, and the whole hall falls silent.

Effective line: You hear him breathe in, slow and even. Ten years without iron have left him thin.
Suggested line: He breathes in, slow and even. Ten years without iron have worn him thin as wire, but he stands perfectly straight.

Effective line: Before you, the ruler of the House of Gains takes one step back.
Suggested line: Across the room, the ruler of the House of Gains takes one step back.

Effective line: The weights are back! I cried. Then I did a set. Then I cried again.
Suggested line: The weights are back! I cried, then I did a set, and then I cried all over again.

Effective line: Ask a Beefcake. They have loads. And now they keep it.
Suggested line: Ask any Beefcake. They have loads of it, and now they get to keep some.

Effective line: Back under the old management. The old management is still jacked.
Suggested line: Back under the old management. The old management can still bench a hay cart.

Effective line: YOU DID IT. Flex is out, Clench is down, and I got to watch. Best day since... since the last best day. I'm spotting you from now on, like it or not.
Suggested line: You did it! Flex is out, Clench is down, and I got to watch the whole thing. Best day since... oh, since the last best day, whenever that was. I'm spotting you from now on, like it or not.

Effective line: The weights are back in the gym. There's Gary, lifting. With a spotter. Beautiful. Before you go... that boy I told you about, the old king's son, at the Festival.
Suggested line: Weights back in the gym, and there's Gary, lifting with a proper spotter. Beautiful. Before you go... that boy I told you about, the old king's son, at the Festival...

Effective line: When you lifted that last regime brute, you made the same face he did. Exactly the same face.
Suggested line: When you heaved that last regime brute off his feet, you made the same face he made on my dumbbell. The very same face. Funny, the things you remember.

Effective line: Free, strong and spotted. Thank you, friend. I climbed Swolympus once, you know. These ten years were steeper.
Suggested line: Free, strong and properly spotted, all of us. Thank you, friend. I climbed Swolympus once, you know, and these ten years were steeper.

Effective line: That gate up on the overlook? Sealed. Opens when the kingdom is whole again. Not a day before. I asked it nicely.
Suggested line: That gate up on the overlook is still sealed. It opens when the kingdom is whole again, and not a day before. I asked it nicely. Twice.

Effective line: Foreman Gus. Still on the wheels. Listen to that.
Suggested line: Foreman Gus, still on the wheels. But listen to them now - not a single whistle.

Effective line: I might cry into the wheel for energy. Voluntarily, for once.
Suggested line: I might even take a day off. No idea how it's done, but I hear you start by sitting down.

Effective line: CARDS ON SHELVES, IRON ON RACKS! I can finally shout about the floorboard, and I'VE FORGOTTEN HOW!
Suggested line: CARDS ON SHELVES, IRON ON RACKS! And I don't have to whisper about the floorboard any more, which is good, because I WAS NEVER ANY GOOD AT IT!

Effective line: Welcome, friend. Grandmaster Flex. Ten years in the dark, and the first thing I wanted was a window. The second was a stretch.
Suggested line: Welcome, friend. Grandmaster Flex, at your service. After ten years in the dark, the first thing I wanted was a window, and the second was a good long stretch.

Effective line: They took my plates, my protein, my pre-workout. So I breathed. Breathe in. Hold. ...That is what I did for ten years.
Suggested line: They took my plates, my protein, everything I had ever lifted. So I breathed: in, hold, and out again. That is what I did for ten years, and it was enough.

Effective line: I counted my own heartbeats until they became songs. They thought they were breaking me. They were teaching me.
Suggested line: I counted my own heartbeats until they turned into songs. They thought they were breaking me down there, son, but they were teaching me.

Effective line: Clench is learning to lift from zero. The strongest take the longest. Yesterday he spotted Gary without being asked. The gym is open to everyone now; come whenever you like.
Suggested line: Clench is learning to lift from zero, and the strongest always take the longest. Yesterday he spotted Gary without being asked. The gym is open to everyone now, so come whenever you like.

Effective line: Quota's gone. Left for the Capital before the dust settled. She always did leave early.
Suggested line: Quota's gone, off to the Capital before the dust had even settled. She always did like to leave early.

Effective line: We'll keep the schedule. It will make good kindling. Breathe, son. Nobody here is on the clock any more.
Suggested line: We'll keep her schedule, since it will make good kindling. And breathe, son - nobody here is on the clock any more.
